muc.title: Too much salt
muc.text: Oversalting doesn't always mean throwing it out; many dishes can be saved if you fix them while still on the stove.

muc.title: Say exactly what happened
muc.text: Tell a chatbot what the dish is, what went wrong and what's left in the kitchen. The clearer the description, the better the fix.

muc.title: Salty, burnt, mushy
muc.text: For salty soup, add water or vegetables; for burnt rice, scoop out the top part first. AI suggests, you taste bit by bit.

muc.title: Truly spoiled? Toss it
muc.text: But food that smells odd, turns slimy or sat out overnight shouldn't be rescued; throw it out to be safe.

muc.title: A dish you once ruined
muc.text: Think of the last dish you ruined, describe it to AI and ask for three ways to save it.
